title: Jalapeño-spiced Mexican Poblano Rajas con Crema
description: Roasted poblano rajas with a creamy crema sauce, flavored with vanilla sugar and cured jalapeños

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper, to taste

instructions: Roast the poblano peppers for 30 minutes, or until the skin is blistered.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool. Peel off the skin, remove the seeds, and cut into strips.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced jalapeños and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the roasted poblano strips and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the vanilla sugar, salt, and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together the crema and 1 tablespoon of water.
Add the crema mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve.
